newsitem.title: USA: Respironics to buy Lifecare International.
newsitem.headline: Respironics to buy Lifecare International.

text.p: Respironics Inc said on Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy Lifecare International Inc for $50 million.
Colorado-based Lifecare develops, manufactures and markets respiratory therapy products, principally for use in the home.
For the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996, Lifecare recorded total sales of $33.1 million, according to Respironics.
Respironics said it will finance the acquisition principally from proceeds of its recent stock offering completed in April 1996.
Subject to regulatory approval and other conditions, the deal is expected to close in October, the company said.
